cues.en: Before long a standard news report visual language established itself, one that's immediately recognizable to anyone. Me has this report
cues.zh: 没过多久，一种标准的新闻报道视觉语言就确立起来，任何人都能一眼认出。我手上有这篇报道

cues.en: It starts here with a lackluster establishing shot of a significant location. Next, a walkie talkie preamble from the auteur
cues.zh: 它从这里开始：一个重要地点，配一个平平无奇的全景定场镜头。接着，这位作者导演来了一段对讲机式开场白

cues.en: pacing steadily towards the lens
cues.zh: 稳步朝镜头走来

cues.en: punctuating every other sentence with a hand gesture and ignoring all the pricks milling around him [like] [he's] gliding through the fucking Matrix before coming
cues.zh: 每隔一句就用手势加重语气，无视周围晃来晃去的混蛋，[好像] [他] 正滑行穿过他妈的黑客帝国，然后

cues.en: to a halt and posing a question:
cues.zh: 停下脚步，抛出一个问题：

cues.en: What comes next?
cues.zh: 接下来呢？

cues.en: Often, something like this: a filler shot designed to give your eyes something to look at while my voice babbles on about facts. Sometimes
cues.zh: 通常是这样：一段填充镜头，让你的眼睛有东西可看，而我的声音在絮絮叨叨地讲事实。有时候

cues.en: it'll slow down to a halt, turn monochrome, and some of those facts will appear one by one on the screen.
cues.zh: 画面会慢慢停住，变成黑白，其中一些事实会逐条出现在屏幕上。

cues.en: This is followed by the obligatory shots of overweight people with their faces
cues.zh: 接着是必不可少的镜头：超重的人，脸部

cues.en: subtly framed out, after which the report is padded out with the selection of lazy and pointless vox pops.
cues.zh: 被巧妙地框在画面之外，之后报道就用一堆敷衍又毫无意义的街头采访来凑时长。

cues.en: Usually get some inane chatter from people. I think they do have too much;
cues.zh: 通常会听到人们一些无聊的闲扯。我觉得他们确实话太多；

cues.en: I think what we want to hear is actually what's happening and not what other people [think] of it
cues.zh: 我觉得我们真正想听的是实际发生了什么，而不是别人对此怎么看

cues.en: I hate the same sound bites...they're... I don't want some
cues.zh: 我讨厌总是同样的简短套话……它们……我不想要某个

cues.en: punter's opinion usually...no.
cues.zh: 普通人的意见，通常……不。

cues.en: Another bit of dull visual abstraction to plug another gap now before the report segues gracefully into a bit of human interest courtesy of some
cues.zh: 现在再来一段乏味的视觉抽象，填补另一个空档；随后报道会优雅地转入一点人情味内容，多亏某位

cues.en: Dowdy man opening letters in a kitchen and explaining how he's been affected by the issue.
cues.zh: 衣着邋遢的男人在厨房里拆信，解释这件事如何影响了他。

cues.en: When I'm watching the news, I don't really, you know, there's a person talking to me telling me what's going on,
cues.zh: 我看新闻的时候，其实并不，你知道，就是有个人在对我讲话，告诉我发生了什么，

cues.en: and [I] don't really listen to what they're saying.
cues.zh: 而我并不真的听他们在说什么。

cues.en: It's just news. It's just news
cues.zh: 就是新闻而已。就是新闻而已

cues.en: He, unfortunately ,was boring, so to wake you up, this is an animated chart,
cues.zh: 他，不幸的是，很无聊，所以为了让你醒过来，这是一张动画图表，

cues.en: this is a silhouette representing the average family, and this is [a] lighthouse keeper
cues.zh: 这是一个代表普通家庭的剪影，而这是一个灯塔看守人

cues.en: Being beheaded by a laser beam. As we near the end of the report,
cues.zh: 正被一道激光束斩首。随着报道接近尾声，

cues.en: illustrative shots of pedestrians and signs and a pipe at a window, and then the final summary ending on a whimsical shot of something nearby,
cues.zh: 展示行人、标牌和窗边一根管子的说明性镜头，然后最终总结以一个附近某物的古怪镜头收尾，

cues.en: accompanied by a wry sign-off: if you're lucky, a bit of wordplay fit for a king or in other words, a regent's treat.
cues.zh: 并配上一句揶揄的结束语：运气好的话，还会来点配得上国王的文字游戏，换句话说，是摄政王的一份享受。
